author: CNN
description: Tennessee state Rep. Justin Jones, a Democrat, speaks to CNN's Fredricka Whitfield about the state legislature's decision to approve new congressional maps that splits up a majority-Black district in Memphis. Tennessee is the first state to pass new congressional districts since a US Supreme Court ruling weakening the Voting Rights Act, which prohibited racial discrimination in voting.
title: State Democratic lawmaker criticizes Tennessee's redistricting map

author: CNN
description: Russia’s Victory Day parade, which commemorates the Soviet Union's victory over Nazi Germany in World War II, was scaled down amid fears of Ukrainian drone attacks. Usually known for its dazzling display of heavy military equipment, this year looked very different, with tanks and heavy weapons missing from Red Square, after a three-day ceasefire in the Ukraine war, brokered by US President Donald Trump, took effect May 9. CNN's Fred Pleitgen reports from Moscow.
title: Putin hosts sober Victory Day parade in Moscow amid security concerns

author: CNN
description: It’s been 30 years since Kristin Smart disappeared from the campus of California Polytechnic State University in 1996, sparking a decadeslong investigation that led to the trial and conviction in 2022 of Paul Flores for her murder. Smart was declared dead in 2002, but her body has never been recovered. Now, authorities are reopening the case. CNN’s Josh Campbell explains why. #cnn, #news, #murder, #mystery
title: Why authorities are reopening Kristin Smart's case 30 years later

description:
The US economy added a stronger-than-expected 115,000 jobs last month and the unemployment rate stayed at 4.3%, an indication of resilience at a time when war and high gas prices loom large.

Meanwhile, consumer sentiment continued to decline this month, reaching a fresh record low as the war in Iran drags on, keeping energy prices elevated.

What explains these divergent trends? A CNN NewsNight panel debates.

description: A cyberattack on the learning platform Canvas disrupted access for several critical hours, leaving students and educators scrambling just as many were preparing for final exams. The outage hit hard: Canvas serves nearly 30 million active users worldwide and supports more than 8,000 educational institutions. CNN’s Natasha Chen reports on the impact of the attack.
title: What is Canvas and why is the hack a big deal?
